subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should internal inter-session orphan leaves be removed before the fresh prompt, or should the broader repair path in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 own the stale-reply fix semantics?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same stale-reply issue but encode different treatment of orphaned user-role session state, and current helper tests do not settle the maintainer-owned prompt/session semantic choice.

options.title: Choose canonical semantics first
options.body: Pause merge until maintainers decide whether stale internal orphan leaves should be dropped or preserved as context-only through the broader repair.

options.title: Keep this narrow drop rule
options.body: Proceed with this PR only after redacted embedded-agent proof shows the six-source internal-handoff drop rule is correct and not overly broad.

options.title: Adopt the broader proven branch
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the landing path if maintainers accept its preserve-as-context contract and consider this narrower drop rule unnecessary.

recommendation.title: Choose canonical semantics first
recommendation.body: Pause merge until maintainers decide whether stale internal orphan leaves should be dropped or preserved as context-only through the broader repair.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced in the active-turn repair PR.
